## Nebraska Football Box Scores (1962–2024) {.unnumbered}


### Description

Game-level team statistics for all Nebraska Cornhuskers football games
from September 1962 through the 2024 season. Includes scoring, rushing,
passing, turnovers, penalties, point spreads, and weather data.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>huskers
</code></pre>


### Format

A data frame with columns:


<dl>
<dt>date</dt><dd>Date the game was played.
</dd>
<dt>time_ct</dt><dd>Kickoff time (Central Time).
</dd>
<dt>season</dt><dd>Season (year) the game was played.
</dd>
<dt>opp</dt><dd>Nebraska's opponent.
</dd>
<dt>site</dt><dd>Game location: &quot;Home&quot;, &quot;Away&quot;, &quot;Neutral (home)&quot;, or &quot;Neutral (away)&quot;.
</dd>
<dt>conference</dt><dd>Conference game: &quot;Conference&quot; or &quot;Non-conference&quot;.
</dd>
<dt>result</dt><dd>Game result: &quot;Win&quot;, &quot;Loss&quot;, or &quot;Tie&quot;.
</dd>
<dt>opp_rank</dt><dd>Opponent's ranking entering the game (CFP when available, otherwise AP).
</dd>
<dt>ne_rank</dt><dd>Nebraska's ranking entering the game (CFP when available, otherwise AP).
</dd>
<dt>opp_score</dt><dd>Opponent's total score.
</dd>
<dt>ne_score</dt><dd>Nebraska's total score.
</dd>
<dt>opp_score_q1</dt><dd>Opponent's first quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>opp_score_q2</dt><dd>Opponent's second quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>opp_score_q3</dt><dd>Opponent's third quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>opp_score_q4</dt><dd>Opponent's fourth quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>opp_score_ot</dt><dd>Opponent's overtime points.
</dd>
<dt>ne_score_q1</dt><dd>Nebraska's first quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>ne_score_q2</dt><dd>Nebraska's second quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>ne_score_q3</dt><dd>Nebraska's third quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>ne_score_q4</dt><dd>Nebraska's fourth quarter points.
</dd>
<dt>ne_score_ot</dt><dd>Nebraska's overtime points.
</dd>
<dt>opp_rush_att</dt><dd>Opponent's rushing attempts.
</dd>
<dt>opp_rush_yards</dt><dd>Opponent's rushing yards.
</dd>
<dt>ne_rush_att</dt><dd>Nebraska's rushing attempts.
</dd>
<dt>ne_rush_yards</dt><dd>Nebraska's rushing yards.
</dd>
<dt>opp_pass_comp</dt><dd>Opponent's passing completions.
</dd>
<dt>opp_pass_att</dt><dd>Opponent's passing attempts.
</dd>
<dt>opp_pass_yards</dt><dd>Opponent's passing yards.
</dd>
<dt>ne_pass_comp</dt><dd>Nebraska's passing completions.
</dd>
<dt>ne_pass_att</dt><dd>Nebraska's passing attempts.
</dd>
<dt>ne_pass_yards</dt><dd>Nebraska's passing yards.
</dd>
<dt>opp_first_downs</dt><dd>Opponent's first downs.
</dd>
<dt>ne_first_downs</dt><dd>Nebraska's first downs.
</dd>
<dt>opp_third_down_comp</dt><dd>Opponent's successful third down conversions.
</dd>
<dt>opp_third_down_att</dt><dd>Opponent's third down attempts.
</dd>
<dt>ne_third_down_comp</dt><dd>Nebraska's successful third down conversions.
</dd>
<dt>ne_third_down_att</dt><dd>Nebraska's third down attempts.
</dd>
<dt>opp_fourth_down_comp</dt><dd>Opponent's successful fourth down conversions.
</dd>
<dt>opp_fourth_down_att</dt><dd>Opponent's fourth down attempts.
</dd>
<dt>ne_fourth_down_comp</dt><dd>Nebraska's successful fourth down conversions.
</dd>
<dt>ne_fourth_down_att</dt><dd>Nebraska's fourth down attempts.
</dd>
<dt>opp_int</dt><dd>Interceptions thrown by the opponent.
</dd>
<dt>opp_fum</dt><dd>Fumbles lost by the opponent.
</dd>
<dt>ne_int</dt><dd>Interceptions thrown by Nebraska.
</dd>
<dt>ne_fum</dt><dd>Fumbles lost by Nebraska.
</dd>
<dt>opp_pen_num</dt><dd>Opponent's number of penalties.
</dd>
<dt>opp_pen_yards</dt><dd>Opponent's penalty yards.
</dd>
<dt>ne_pen_num</dt><dd>Nebraska's number of penalties.
</dd>
<dt>ne_pen_yards</dt><dd>Nebraska's penalty yards.
</dd>
<dt>opp_possession</dt><dd>Opponent's time of possession (MM:SS).
</dd>
<dt>ne_possession</dt><dd>Nebraska's time of possession (MM:SS).
</dd>
<dt>spread</dt><dd>Point spread. Negative means Nebraska was favored.
</dd>
<dt>total</dt><dd>Betting total (Over/Under).
</dd>
<dt>temp</dt><dd>Temperature at kickoff (Fahrenheit).
</dd>
<dt>humidity</dt><dd>Relative humidity at kickoff (0.0 to 1.0).
</dd>
<dt>wind_speed</dt><dd>Wind speed at kickoff (mph).
</dd>
<dt>wind_bearing</dt><dd>Wind direction at kickoff in degrees (0 = North, clockwise).
</dd>
<dt>win</dt><dd>Whether Nebraska won: &quot;Yes&quot; or &quot;No&quot;. Derived from <code>result</code>
(Win = Yes; Loss and Tie = No).
</dd>
<dt>home</dt><dd>Whether it was a Nebraska home game: &quot;Yes&quot; or &quot;No&quot;. Derived
from <code>site</code> (Home and Neutral-home = Yes; Away and Neutral-away = No).
</dd>
</dl>



### Details

Data completeness notes:


<ul>
<li> Scoring by quarter, first down, third/fourth down, and opponent penalty
data begins in the 2004 season.

</li>
<li> Nebraska penalty data is incomplete before 1972-09-16 (Texas A&amp;M).

</li>
<li> Time of possession data begins in 2012, complete from 2013 onward.

</li>
<li> Point spread data is mostly absent before 1978; available for most
games from 1978 onward.

</li>
<li> Betting total data is available for most games from 2006 onward.

</li>
<li> Weather data sourced from the DarkSky API and Weather Underground.
Temperature and humidity are fairly reliable; wind data less so.

</li></ul>



### Source

Compiled from historical Nebraska football records.
